backgroundActivity.kind: possible CPU overlap, not a demonstrated cause
backgroundActivity.interpretation: The conservative window overlaps both medium run windows. Exact timing, affected scenario/frame, and magnitude are unknown. Do not assign observed improvements or regressions to this activity, do not subtract duration, and do not discard only unfavorable rows.

limitations: One A/B pair on SwiftShader software rendering; not physical GPU or real smartphone performance.
No actual FPS, 1% Low FPS, GPU time, GPU/VRAM bytes, or loading-time inference from this review. gpuTimer=true means extension available, not timer query samples.
Synthetic performance clock and disabled note scheduler; this is not audio scheduling, sync, or listening validation.
CDP TaskDuration can include synchronous driver waits and QA overhead; ThreadTime/ScriptDuration are distinct metrics, not CPU utilization percentages.

Every recorded performance.memory sample is exactly 410,000,000 bytes; its precision and coverage are not established by these samples and its values differ from CDP JSHeapUsedSize. Do not equate either with total process memory, geometry ArrayBuffers or VRAM; GC/snapshot timing can change CDP heap.

PNG hashes only: visual quality, exact RGB equality, MAE/RMSE/SSIM are not newly assessed. Equal hash identifies identical encoded files under the stated hash check; unequal hash alone does not establish pixel differences.
Per-scenario p95/p99 from 8 samples are maxima and do not establish stable long-tail performance.
No result-driven exclusion was made; all eight scenes, worsened time/CPU/draw/heap metrics and possible background activity are retained.

findings.causality: No single-variable causal attribution. Possible background activity is not an established explanation for any row.
